name: gradient-morpheus-den

frames.best_why: The full vertical blend is visible, from turquoise at the bottom to indigo at the top.

tagline: Deep indigo fades down into turquoise across a rounded panel.
summary: A decorative vertical gradient block that runs from bright turquoise along the bottom up through blue to a dark indigo top, with soft rounded corners.
appearance: A wide rounded rectangle filled by a vertical gradient that starts in vivid turquoise along the bottom edge, passes through blue and settles into a deep indigo at the top. Black margins frame it.
behaviour: Static: nothing moves or responds. The two colour stops are fixed, but extra classes or inline styles can resize and repaint the block.
use_when: A cool teal-to-indigo field is wanted behind a hero, card or media block.
avoid_when: It is static flat colour, and the dark top edge swallows dark text and icons.
customise: The gradient stops are baked into the inline style; pass className or style to resize, round or repaint it, otherwise edit the file.
weight_why: One div with a CSS gradient and no script.

a11y.note: Decorative only: no text, controls or focus, so it carries no information by itself.

polish_why: Smooth vertical blend with a clean rounded shape; still a stock two-colour gradient.
title: Morpheus Den
